d: PM Modi on Dimagi Naxal: pradhanmantri narendr modi ne is bar divali javanon ke sath manaee... chhattisgarh ke bastar men javanon ke bich pahunche piem modi ne naksalvad ko lekar aisa bayan diya...jisne desh ki siyasat men naee bahas chher di...piem modi ne kaha ki janglon se hathiyarband naksaliyon ka saphaya ho chuka hai... lekin ab desh ke samne dimagi naksaliyon ki chunauti baki hai... piem ke is bayan par bihar men siyasi ghamasan chhir gaya hai... tejasvi yadav se lekar aarjedi aur kangres ke netaon ne saval uthae, to bijepi aur jediyu ne pradhanmantri ke bayan ka samarthan kiya…
